Df.bar_b_note: B's mossy olive surface is on-style naturalistic but the face and eyes never pop, the faint-end pose collapses into a shapeless mound, and A's lime-and-black toy camouflage is nowhere near the Palworld creature finish.

Uh.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing grandfatherly villager with a warm earthy palette and a clear face that would sit beside Palworld's stylised humans, held back only by a slightly more cartoon face than the key-art world.

Sh.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped text and icon-led Craft/Leave hints read at a glance, but the panel lacks the teal interaction accent and controller-glyph polish of a shipping UI and sits over a murky, flat dark world.

Sn.bar_b_note: The Voltarach spider reads, but flat magenta telegraph shapes, a tiny near-invisible player creature, heavy HUD panels and a dim brown floor with no purple storm sky or lightning sink it, and A also loses whole frames to camera-in-foliage.

Hv.bar_b_note: B's white-and-ice-blue wolf has a crisp, taller-than-trainer silhouette near the owner style bar, but white-on-white faces with weak eye read and A's odd upright faint-end pose keep it below Palworld creature finish.

top_changes.change: Stormwood fight (Sn): add camera collision/foliage fade so trunks and canopy never fill the frame, replace the flat magenta telegraph rings and rectangles with grounded white-violet lightning and stone-impact effects, put the player's creature in a readable rim-lit spot, and restore the purple storm sky grade.

Creature face and value read (Df, Hv): give eyes a bright, high-contrast iris and highlight, add rim light and darker accent values around the head so the face separates on grey and white, and keep a recognisable head-and-body silhouette in faint poses instead of a flattened mound or upright crouch.

Moss-newt creature (Df): rebuild as a clearly headed, taller hero model matching the Mosshock board (big amber eyes, moss crown, pale belly), so it stands taller than the 1.80 m trainer and its face reads at 30%.
